# The drape kernels (Cut 5), by their Lean/Slang module names, each with the
# targets it is compiled for:
#   both   cpp (the in-guest CPU path) and spirv (the GPU path over rd_compute)
#   spirv  groupshared + barrier, which slangc -target cpp rejects
#   cpp    the one-thread *_serial sibling such a kernel needs on the CPU path
# L-BFGS-B, in the order a minimize iteration dispatches them:
lb_box_project both
lb_pg_inf spirv
lb_pg_inf_serial cpp
lb_step_max spirv
lb_step_max_serial cpp
lb_multi_dot spirv
lb_multi_dot_serial cpp
lb_compact both
lb_ring_store both
lb_apply_m both
lb_cauchy both
lb_subspace both
# Reused from lean/Cloth (line search x = xp + step*d, and g.d):
saxpby both
dot_reduce spirv
dot_reduce_serial cpp
